name: Starter Kit
audience: Businesses with pixel props of their own, or anyone starting with the control system and adding props later
headline: The complete control system, ready for props.
summary: Everything that runs a Resonate show, built and tested in one weatherproof enclosure: the Raspberry Pi 5 Light Show controller and its USB microphone, a Kulp pixel controller running Falcon Player, power supplies and pre-wired pigtails on every output. Plug in your own pixel props or add ours, join the controller's Wi-Fi from any phone, and the show runs.
bestFor: Making an existing pixel display music-reactive
Venues adding props over several seasons
Testing the system before a larger rollout

name: Business Kit
audience: Restaurants, patios, storefronts, hotel entrances and single commercial frontages
headline: One mega tree that listens to the room.
summary: The Business Kit is the control system plus a music-reactive mega tree, configured before it ships. Put it at the entrance, on the patio or in the courtyard; it follows the music you already play and runs on a schedule, with staff changing themes from a phone.

name: Plaza / BIA Kit
audience: Business Improvement Areas, main streets, town squares and multi-tenant plazas
headline: Two mega trees and four smaller props, one show.
summary: Sized for a square or a block: two mega trees, two wrapped trees and a pair of walk-through arches, all synchronised from one control system. Each prop can run its own look, and everything can join one theme for launch nights and events.
bestFor: Business Improvement Areas (BIAs, BIDs, BIZ, SDCs)

name: Municipal Program
audience: Municipalities, downtown programs, parks, civic squares and tourism offices
headline: A public light show your whole community comes out for.
summary: A civic-scale program: four mega trees, ten smaller props (wrapped trees, walk-through arches and evergreen spirals) and rooflines on two civic buildings, scheduled from one system. Scoped in phases to fit budget cycles, with itemised quotes for council and procurement.
